name: CARNAGE [//:]
desc:
participate in a killing game with an eccentric host.
game is still in its early stage, treat it fairly as it is nowhere near its finished state. (ALPHA)
updates every 1 to 2 weeks.

=============================================================
♜ Keybinds :
• handbook (menu) > M
• sprint > double tap W/ hold button while walking / L2
• skip dialogue > E/SpaceBar/Enter/Click
• switch bullet mode (In Trial) > Q/E/[TOUCH THE GUN] Hold R to switch between evidence
• drag/report > hold Q/E or hold the UI (press S to walk in dragging mode.)
